messages.subject: forest plot
parts:
I've created a forest plot based on the code that has been previously referenced in this discussion group, using geom_pointrange with coord_flip.   For presentation purposes, however, I was wondering if anyone could tell me if ggplot2 will allow me to put perpendicular end-caps on the end of the geom_pointrange (like a box and whiskers plot), just so the end of the line is more apparent.   Also, is it possible to eliminate the gray background, but maintain the grid in the background (i.e. exchange the coloring of the gray background, white grid - so I end up with a grey grid and white background).  

Thanks -
Matthew

On 12-04-02 11:40 AM, Robert Strother wrote:
> I've created a forest plot based on the code that has been previously
> referenced in this discussion group, using geom_pointrange with
> coord_flip. For presentation purposes, however, I was wondering if anyone
> could tell me if ggplot2 will allow me to put perpendicular end-caps on the
> end of the geom_pointrange (like a box and whiskers plot), just so the end
> of the line is more apparent. Also, is it possible to eliminate the gray
> background, but maintain the grid in the background (i.e. exchange the
> coloring of the gray background, white grid - so I end up with a grey grid
> and white background).
>
> Thanks -
> Matthew
>

I think that geom_pointrange() + end caps = geom_errorbar() (maybe
geom_point() + geom_errorbar())

grey grid on white background = + theme_bw()

messages.subject: Re: forest plot
parts:
Thanks - that worked.  I had to hadd geom_point to include the mean value on the geom_errorbar crossbar. 

Thanks
